cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Challenge by Proxy
cards.instruction: Persuade someone else to challenge a rule or authority before you risk doing it yourself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Will you challenge the captain's queue-jumping rule at tonight's club meeting?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He cancelled my booking last time I complained.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Ask him to restore your booking as well. I'll draft both requests for your speech.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then sign it. I want him to know it's both of us.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll leave space for my signature. Once he's agreed you have a point, call me up to add it.

mechanism: A edits a challenge into formal requests while withholding a signature until B has tested the captain response.
confusable: D52 endorsement collection asks backing; here A avoids giving own endorsement until someone else risks challenging authority.
comparison: Director alternative hides behind the speaker; club alternative withholds written co-ownership until the challenge succeeds.
seedUse: Captain queue rule, cancelled booking, drafted speech and delayed signature derive from D56-b; S03 supplies corrective drafting.
